_comment: Copy to profiles/apply_profile.json (gitignored) and fill in. Every value here is transmitted to employers verbatim, so review each one. Anything absent stays blank and is asked in Discord instead.
_identity_comment: preferred_name defaults to first_name, and legal_name defaults to full name, if left blank. Fill city/state/zip/country separately for employers that split address into its own fields; location still covers a single combined field.
_questions_comment: Sponsorship, legal, demographic, consent, pay, availability and clearance questions are never inferred from the contact details above. Each one needs an entry here. `match` is matched as lowercase alphanumeric text against the employer's field label; keep it specific enough that it cannot hit a different question. Checkbox answers must be true or false. Select, combobox (Greenhouse's custom country/yes-no picker) and radio-style answers must equal one of the employer's own options. A grouped checkbox question (for example 'which clearances do you hold, select all that apply') needs a list of the option label(s) to check; an empty list leaves every box unchecked.

questions.match: will you now or in the future require sponsorship
